verdict.rationale: Greenhouse documents a reporting/insights module (custom reports by candidates, sources, departments, filters) and a general API for candidate/application data (docs-6, docs-23, docs-31, docs-1, docs-20), which analysts could use to pull data out. However there is no evidence of scheduled exports, a dedicated reporting API endpoint, or BI-tool connectors (e.g., Tableau/Looker/Power BI), and probes for an OpenAPI/swagger spec all 404, suggesting limited documented API discoverability for data warehousing use cases. Missing for 10: explicit scheduled export feature, BI connector documentation, and a discoverable reporting/analytics API spec.
